limitations: Conjunction identity ignores comments/status/whitespace, not logical equivalence.
One source corpus and first qualifying exports; quotas do not establish representativeness.
No warm basis, assignment, reason graph or original Boolean context is replayed.
Whole-process timeouts and unfinished checks are censored, not completed durations.
No algorithmic winner, speedup or default promotion is claimed.
normalization: Token order retained; comments, whitespace and status annotations ignored. No logical equivalence, renaming or assertion reordering test.
warm_max_pivots_scope: Completed-call export records only; zero is the absent-record default for retained captures. Captured-call completions remain in selection.json.

qualify_superseded.reason: Queued wrapper snapshot lacked later required tool-identities argument. Canceled before execution; replaced with current committed wrapper.

qualify_without_label_proof.reason: Short timings left one known-SAT label without a fresh model proof. Artifact audit was canceled; supplementary model stage and a dependent audit replace it. Timing rows unchanged.

source_extraction.stage_scope: Instrumented parent runs are extraction diagnostics; SAT-model qualification covers the selected conjunctions, not all parent SAT answers.

verification.native_gate: Reuse exact d4944eb binary qualification from 2026-10-30-lra-uncompleted-call-capture; no fresh C++ test, ASan, fuzz or static-scan claim.
verification.preflight: Repository --check-only --no-sync from clean d4944eb worktree immediately before every submission; actual private route and workspace stay outside tracked files.
